says: Arm.ts says scheduled.yaml's report job runs only on main and that a red leg's `stop the run` step cancels its own run; since pull request 1383 the report runs on every branch on `always()` and no step cancels the run, so SKIPPED_BY_DESIGN and the header describe a workflow that no longer exists.
proof: Arm.ts line 34 reads "(`if: always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`), so every green branch run skips it" and line 9 names "`stop the run`"; .github/workflows/scheduled.yaml line 200 reads "if: always()" and workflow-lint SC4 fails any step that cancels the run.
cost: A reader of the merge check trusts a skip rule and a cancel story that no longer happen, and may keep `report` in SKIPPED_BY_DESIGN, which would let a branch run whose report was skipped for a real fault count as green.
